rationale: The workflow is a simple manually-triggered (workflow_dispatch) job that runs a PowerShell script to generate markdown and pushes to a wiki via a Docker action. It has no push/PR triggers, no matrix, no scheduled runs, no dependency installation, and no test suite. The available evidence patterns require preconditions not met here: P-LIT-CANCEL-STALE needs superseding runs on same branch/PR (only manual runs); P-LIT-CUSTOM-TIMEOUT needs representative successful-duration history (ci_history shows no_completed_runs); P-LIT-GHA-CACHE needs repeated dependency fetching (none present); P-LIT-FAIL-SCHEDULE and P-LIT-IDLE-SCHEDULE need schedule triggers (none); P-LIT-CHANGE-FILTER needs path-based triggers (commented out); other patterns target Bazel, test selection, or environment caching which do not apply. No evidence-supported optimization fits this workflow's characteristics while preserving its intended behavior.
